Class WebSocketTckTags

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.server.tck.WebSocketTckTags
public final class WebSocketTckTags extends Object
The JUnit tags of the WebSocket tests of the server TCK. Every WebSocket test carries WEBSOCKET; a test of an operation that a server implementation might not support carries the tag of that operation too, so that a runner can exclude just that operation, e.g. @ExcludeTags(WebSocketTckTags.WEBSOCKET_SUBPROTOCOL), or every WebSocket test with @ExcludeTags(WebSocketTckTags.WEBSOCKET).
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

      public static final String WEBSOCKET
      Every WebSocket test. Excluding it skips all of them, for a server that cannot upgrade a connection to WebSocket at all, e.g. a servlet container or a function runtime.
